hook: AI agents may soon shop for you on Amazon.
hookText: AI agents may soon shop for you on Amazon

beats.say: Amazon and Meta are reportedly in talks about how third-party AI systems can connect to Amazon's store and shop on users' behalf.
Amazon's CEO said in October that AI agents are not yet having a meaningful impact on its ads business.
Many shoppers stay wary of trusting AI shopping agents completely, but experts say this may be the first Black Friday where agents matter.
